scope: Exploratory diagnostics of completed frozen models; no primary selection is changed

static_independence.trial: first validation trial in the frozen manifest
static_independence.negative_control: sequence-mean coupling using the existing synthetic test definition

temporal.operation: multiply every off-center temporal kernel slice by retention; retain center slices and every other parameter

spatial.operation: multiply only the first spatial convolution weight tensor by retention; leave bias, temporal kernels, other spatial layers, readout, shifter and BatchNorm unchanged
spatial.criterion: nearest mean per-neuron Pearson correlation pooled over validation trial and time samples
spatial.test_rule: freeze selected strengths before test; report all failed validation or test matches without retuning

statistics.conventional_interval_estimand: equal-weight mean of condition scores, reported separately

zero_retention_interpretation: The center-only visual core retains the frame aligned 9 frames before the reported output; pupil shifting retains the current frame. It is not the Static model.
